Alex Arce.note: Arce is the forward Paraguay can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Alex Arce.noteZh: 他给Paraguay替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Alexandro Maidana.note: Maidana is the kind of defender Paraguay can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Alexandro Maidana.noteZh: 他是Paraguay艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Andres Cubas.note: Cubas gives Paraguay structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Andres Cubas.noteZh: 他给Paraguay控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

Antonio Sanabria.note: Sanabria is attacking depth for Paraguay. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Antonio Sanabria.noteZh: 他是Paraguay前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Braian Ojeda.note: Ojeda is midfield insurance for Paraguay. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Braian Ojeda.noteZh: 他给Paraguay一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Damian Bobadilla.note: Bobadilla is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Paraguay, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Damian Bobadilla.noteZh: 他给Paraguay提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Diego Gomez.summary: Diego Gómez is a Paraguay central midfielder from Brighton & Hove Albion who gives the national team powerful carrying, midfield shooting, and box-to-box range.
Diego Gomez.note: Gómez is a tempo player for Paraguay. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Diego Gomez.noteZh: 他让Paraguay在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Fabian Balbuena.note: Balbuena is back-line insurance for Paraguay. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Fabian Balbuena.noteZh: 他给Paraguay那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Gabriel Avalos.note: Ávalos is an attacking change-up for Paraguay. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Gabriel Avalos.noteZh: 他是Paraguay的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Gaston Olveira.note: Olveira gives Paraguay a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Gaston Olveira.noteZh: 他在Paraguay首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Gatito Fernandez.note: Fernández is goalkeeper cover for Paraguay. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Gatito Fernandez.noteZh: 他是Paraguay门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Gustavo Caballero.note: Caballero is an attacking change-up for Paraguay. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Gustavo Caballero.noteZh: 他是Paraguay的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Gustavo Gomez.note: Gómez has been part of Paraguay's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Gustavo Gomez.noteZh: 他在Paraguay体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Gustavo Velazquez.note: Velázquez gives Paraguay cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Gustavo Velazquez.noteZh: 他是Paraguay后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Isidro Pitta.note: Pitta is an attacking change-up for Paraguay. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Isidro Pitta.noteZh: 他是Paraguay的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Jose Canale.note: Canale is the kind of defender Paraguay can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Jose Canale.noteZh: 他是Paraguay艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Juan Jose Caceres.note: Cáceres gives Paraguay one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Juan Jose Caceres.noteZh: 他是Paraguay无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Julio Enciso.note: Enciso has shown both sides of the attacking job for Paraguay. One action can pull the defender, and the next one can decide the chance.
Julio Enciso.noteZh: 他给Paraguay展示了进攻工作的两面。一脚拉开防守，下一脚就可能决定机会。

Junior Alonso.note: Alonso has been part of Paraguay's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Junior Alonso.noteZh: 他在Paraguay体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Kaku.summary: Kaku is a Paraguay attacking midfielder from Al-Ain who gives the national team left-footed creativity, final passes, and set-piece service.
Kaku.note: Kaku is midfield insurance for Paraguay. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Kaku.noteZh: 他给Paraguay一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Matias Galarza.note: Galarza has both scored and created for Paraguay in this run. He matters because the same movement can become the shot or the pass before it.
Matias Galarza.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Paraguay贡献进球和传球。防守者必须同时判断射门和分球。

Mauricio.note: Maurício has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against United States. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Mauricio.noteZh: 他已经为Paraguay进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Miguel Almiron.note: Almirón gives Paraguay structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Miguel Almiron.noteZh: 他给Paraguay控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

Omar Alderete.note: Alderete has been part of Paraguay's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Omar Alderete.noteZh: 他在Paraguay体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Orlando Gill.note: Gill is the last voice in Paraguay's defensive shape. When pressure sticks, his job is to make the next action feel simple.
Orlando Gill.noteZh: 他承担了Paraguay的门将时间。重点是稳手、清楚开球，以及让身前后卫不用慌。

Ramon Sosa.note: Sosa is attacking depth for Paraguay. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Ramon Sosa.noteZh: 他是Paraguay前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。
